name: RUTH
canonical: Ruth, a young Moabite widow of about twenty-five, sun-warmed olive skin and dark hair bound under a worn russet head-veil, gentle steadfast eyes in a weary lovely face, dressed in a patched and dusty coarse-woven robe of faded earthen tones girded for labour, bare forearms and dirt-stained hands clutching a gleaned sheaf of barley scraps in a humble field
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
